title: VIF-Bench: Evaluating Visual Instruction Following in Multi-Reference Image Generation
abstract: arXiv:2609.37709v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Recent multimodal image generation models can take multiple images and textual instructions as input, enabling reference-based generation guided not only by text but also by visual instructions such as layouts, arrows, and pose cues. However, existing benchmarks do not evaluate the joint setting in which multiple references must be composed under multiple and heterogeneous visual-instruction images. To address this gap, we introduce VIF-Bench, a benchmark of 1,241 tasks designed to assess the edge of model capabilities in this joint setting by covering: (i) multi-reference generation (up to 7) under multiple heterogeneous visual instructions (up to 6), (ii) cases where reference images can potentially compete with visual instructions (e.g., a strongly posed subject vs. a target pose), and (iii) controlled comparison of visual instructions with text descriptions at different levels of specificity. translated_title: VIF-Bench：评估多参考图像生成中的视觉指令遵循
translated_abstract: 近期的多模态图像生成模型可以接收多张图像和文本指令作为输入，实现不仅由文本引导、还由布局、箭头和姿态线索等视觉指令引导的基于参考的生成。然而，现有基准测试并未评估这样一种联合设置：即在多个异构的视觉指令图像下，模型必须对多个参考图像进行组合。为填补这一空白，我们提出了VIF-Bench，一个包含1,241个任务的基准，旨在评估模型在这种联合设置下的能力边界，具体涵盖：（i）在多达6个异构视觉指令下进行多达7张参考图像的多参考生成；（ii）参考图像可能与视觉指令相互冲突竞争的情况（例如，具有强烈姿态的主体与目标姿态之间的矛盾）；（iii）对不同特异性程度的文本描述与视觉指令进行受控比较。
tldr: 提出了VIF-Bench基准（含1,241个任务），首次系统评估多模态图像生成模型在多参考图像组合与异构视觉指令遵循联合设置下的能力边界，包括参考与指令竞争及文本-视觉指令的受控比较等场景。
en_tdlr: We introduce VIF-Bench, a benchmark of 1,241 tasks that evaluates the capability edge of multimodal image generation models in the joint setting of composing multiple references under multiple heterogeneous visual instructions, including cases where references compete with instructions and controlled comparisons between visual and textual guidance.
